Frontend: cardiologo notice shows, close hides permanently (survives reload); TEST_Cardio3 tabs Anamnesi/Motivo e sintomi/Parametri/Esame obiettivo/Esami strumentali/Diagnosi e terapia; Parametri numeric inputs with mmHg/bpm/%/kg/cm, pressure rows, add/delete measurement, 1200 sistolica shows plausibility with Confermo/Correggi (Correggi clears); no BMI, no dose calculator; Altre voci card with Conferma/Elimina, save persists (verified via API). Module settings card: select with Automatico+5 modules, 19 field rows, hide/up/down, Salva personalizzazione persists across reload, Generale/auto switching, Ripristina resets. One privacy gap found by code review in /portal/children/{pid}/simple.

critical.issue: Returns base.riepilogo = note.riepilogo without checking prov.is_draft(parti.riassunto_famiglia), and also feeds that riepilogo into the LLM 'In parole semplici' prompt. Leak path: visit already published -> doctor regenerates riepilogo (POST summary sets riassunto_famiglia to draft) and saves -> portal 'simple' view exposes the unapproved AI draft. Violates spec 'Riepilogo never visible in portal while unapproved AI draft'. Fix: riepilogo = '' if prov.is_draft(parts.get('riassunto_famiglia')) and exclude it from the prompt in that case (also consider cache invalidation of 'simple').

minor.issue: Hidden non-text module fields (numero/pressione) keep LLM values instead of being cleared (only str fields are blanked). LLM prompt omits hidden fields so usually empty; low impact.
share:true sets guardian_shared_at even for visits that were never hidden (non-gynecology); harmless but noisy audit 'visita_condivisa_tutori'.
